context: A teacher walks a uni student through an environmental law paper
purpose: Teach: 浄化/鉱山/過酷/添加/ガード/租税/陪審/懲役

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: レンくん、環境法のレポート、テーマは鉱山開発の規制でいいのね？
lines.en: Ren, for your environmental law paper, the topic is mining development regulation, right?
lines.style: Warm professorial tone, gentle confirming inflection, soft pacing

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。特に廃水の浄化義務について書きたいんですけど、判例が少なくて…
lines.en: Yes. I want to focus on wastewater purification obligations, but there are few precedents.
lines.style: Earnest student delivery, slightly hesitant trailing off, thoughtful

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: なるほど。鉱山会社が違法な添加物質を流していた事件なら、二〇一八年の判決があるわよ。
lines.en: I see. There's a 2018 ruling on a mining company that released illegal additive substances.
lines.style: Helpful academic guidance, clear measured delivery, encouraging tone

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: あの懲役刑が出たやつですよね？確か社長に三年の判決でした。
lines.en: The one where a prison sentence was handed down, right? Three years for the president, I think.
lines.style: Eager recall, rising confirmation, student showing knowledge

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: そう。あの事件は陪審員制度のある国でも注目されて、租税回避の側面まで議論されたの。
lines.en: Right. That case drew attention even in countries with jury systems, and tax avoidance aspects were debated too.
lines.style: Scholarly contextualizing, measured academic delivery, building depth

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 租税まで関係するんですか…論点を絞らないと収拾つかなくなりそうですね。
lines.en: Even tax matters are connected? I need to narrow the focus or it'll get out of hand.
lines.style: Slight overwhelm, self-aware muttering, processing aloud honestly

lines.speaker: asuka_teacher
lines.jp: ええ、論理のガードを固めて書いてね。労働者が過酷な環境で働かされた点も忘れずに。
lines.en: Yes, keep your logical guard tight when writing. Don't forget the workers were forced into harsh conditions either.
lines.style: Practical advisory tone, firm but caring delivery, structured guidance

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: わかりました。来週までに第一稿、お持ちします。
lines.en: Understood. I'll bring you the first draft by next week.
lines.style: Resolved commitment, respectful closing, motivated and steady
